items: New: a downhill mountain bike! Pick MTB on the track picker for a full-suspension bike with a full-face helmet and goggles, and its own career with its own stars. Watch the suspension squash on every landing and bump. Swipe for a Whip, Tabletop or Turndown, hold on the left for a Superman, No Footer, Can Can or No Hander, and tilt for a manual or a stoppie
New: the DOWNHILL world, only on the bike. Race ten courses down Hillside Town, with steps, wall drops, alley gaps and handrails. Muddy Woods, Boulder Peak and North Shore are coming soon
New: on the bike, rails become wooden skinnies to ride along, and rock gardens rattle you forwards and back. Tilt to keep your balance or you go over the bars

New: two new flip tricks! Swipe down and to the left on the right side for a 360 Flip (a tre flip), where the board flips and spins all the way round. Swipe down and to the right for a Hardflip. They take a bit longer than a kickflip, so do them on big jumps

Better: the game runs smoother on slower phones and tablets. If it starts to stutter, it quietly lowers the picture detail until it's smooth again, and raises it back when it can. There's a QUALITY button on the title screen if you'd rather pick HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW yourself
Better: when your skater pushes, both feet turn to point forward like a real push. Once he's back on the board, his back foot goes on sideways and his front foot swivels round to match

Better: on Temple Rhythm, the challenge "One combo across a rhythm set" is now called "Trick off the 3 jumps in one combo", and its sign says 3 JUMPS. It means the three jumps after the sign, not the rollers. Trick off the first and the last without your combo ending in between
Better: pushing looks like real skating now. Instead of quick little kicks, your skater plants a foot way out in front and drives it right back in one big powerful push

New: tap the menu button while you ride to pause. A big RETRY button at the top starts the track again straight away, so no more going back to all tracks to find it. You can also keep riding or pick another track

Fixed: on the Canyon Mega Ramp the big rock arch stood with one leg hanging in the air over the canyon. It stands on solid ground now, and the far-off mesas in the desert all stand on the desert floor

Better: no more "climb out first time" challenges anywhere. Rattlesnake Ravine and The Big Dip now ask for good pumps, Caldera Rim asks you to clear every lava gap, and Puddle Pump asks for a score of 6,500
Better: Pirate Cove and Moon Base sound like proper skating too, with the same rolling wheels as the park. You can still hear the waves and parrots at the cove and the space base bleeps on the moon
Better: Desert sounds like proper skating now. The wheels roll like on concrete instead of a fizzy hiss, and you can still hear the desert wind around you
Better: on Dry Gulch, "Climb out of every gully first time" is gone. Now pump hard up any gully and pop into the air off its far edge. Miss one? Just try the next gully

Fixed: "Air off the last gully" on The Big Dip (and every gully air challenge) was really hard to get, because you had to ollie in exactly the right spot. Now an ollie anywhere near the top of the gully counts

New: Sky Islands, the last World 2 biome! Complete Moon 5 to ride ten tracks on floating islands high above the clouds. Jump UP from island to island (pump hard on the way in), grind rope rails over the gaps, and spot the sky castle, the windmill and the rainbow. Plus the Cloud Top Mega Ramp

New: the Moon Base! Complete Dino 5 to blast off to the moon. Gravity is low, so every jump floats twice as high and twice as long, with time for loads of tricks. Wear a space helmet, jump giant craters, ride the moon loops and look back at the Earth. Plus the Crater Halfpipe

New: on a scooter, land backwards after a 180 and your combo says Fakie. But scooters don't like going backwards: the longer you ride fakie the wobblier you get until you fall off, so spin another 180 to face forwards again
Better: the scooter rider wears a proper skate helmet

Better: gaps are real gaps now. Look down and you see a ravine cutting through the land behind the track, with a river, lava or goo flowing along it, or a creek, an alley, an icy crevasse, a rocky gully or glowing crystals at the bottom

New: Dino Valley! Complete Mine 5 to ride ten tracks among the dinosaurs. Launch off giant humps shaped like dinosaur backs, jump the sticky tar pits, grind fallen logs and watch out for the volcano. Plus the Long Neck Mega Ramp

New: the Crystal Mine! Complete Toxic 5 to head underground for ten tracks lit by lanterns and glowing crystals. Grind off the end of one mine-cart rail and drop onto the next, pump up the rails that climb the rock, and jump the dark mine shafts. Plus the Mine Shaft Mega Ramp

New: the Toxic Factory! Complete Funfair 5 to open ten tracks full of green goo. Green conveyor belts zoom you along, red ones try to hold you back, so pump hard all the way across them. Plus the Smokestack Mega Ramp
New: the Funfair! Complete Haunted 5 to open ten fairground tracks. Ride two loops in a row (pump the dip between them!), grind the roller coaster, jump the bumper cars and take on the Big Dipper

New: Haunted Hollow! Complete Pirate 5 to open eight spooky tracks after dark. Roll off big drop-offs and land on the slope to keep your speed, grind the crooked bridge and the ghost train, and look out for friendly ghosts
New: Pirate Cove! Complete Docks 5 to open eight pirate tracks. Hop across stepping stones in the sea, pumping each landing, walk the plank, fire off the cannon ramps, and ride the Galleon Bowl

Fixed: after the finish line you roll to a stop instead of riding off the end of the world, and there's only one FINISH sign now. Half pipe and mega ramp decks are longer too, so you never see past the end

Better: no more looking into nothing when you jump a gap. Gaps now have walls and something at the bottom: a creek in the park, an alley between the rooftops, an icy blue crevasse in the snow and a rocky gully in the desert

New: scooters! Tap SCOOTER above the worlds to start a whole new career with its own stars and new challenges on every track. Finish a track on either the skateboard or the scooter and the next one opens for both

New: scooter tricks! On the right, swipe up to bunny hop, left for a tailwhip, right for a barspin and down for a heelwhip, and swipe again in the air for doubles, swipe and hold on the left for a Superman, No Footer, Can Can or X-Up, and on rails do feebles and smiths. The Trick Guide has a SCOOTER page
New: on the snow you ride a snow scooter with skis instead of wheels
Fixed: the forklift on the docks has a proper roof on posts, not one floating in the air
New: Harbour Docks! Complete Candy 5 to open ten harbour tracks. Manual along the tops of shipping containers, grind the quay, jump the water between the piers, and ride the Harbour Crane Mega Ramp
Fixed: the skyscrapers in Downtown Rooftops no longer float in the sky. They stand on the street far below, with more city stretching away behind them

New: Candy Kingdom! Complete Farm 5 to open eight sweet tracks with jelly pads that go BOING, a chocolate river, candy cane rails and a Jelly Bowl half pipe. Pump as you hit a jelly pad to fly even higher
New: on Autumn Farm you ride a mountain board with big tyres and a helmet. Your feet are strapped in like on a snowboard, so you do shifties and tuck knees instead of board flips
New: World 2! Complete Volcano 5 to open Autumn Farm: eight muddy tracks with hay bale jumps, fence rails, ditches and a barn half pipe. Mud slows you down, so pump through it
Better: the ollie is slower, so you can see him crouch, snap the tail and spring up
Better: the downhill slopes you land on after jumps are steeper
Better: kickers have a flat top again. Go fast and you fly onto the downhill, go slow and you land on the flat and lose speed. Gaps are wider too, so you need to pump to clear them
New: back up your stars! Tap MY STARS on the title screen, then SAVE BACKUP to keep them in Files, iCloud Drive or Google Drive. LOAD BACKUP brings them back
New: a new home screen icon of you flying over the desert arch. On an iPad, take the game off your home screen and add it again to see it
Better: the ALL TRACKS button is tucked away again. Any tracks it opened stay open
New: an ALL TRACKS button on the title screen opens every track, so you can get back to where you were
New: Move My Stars! If you put the game on your home screen, tap COPY MY STARS in Safari, then PASTE MY STARS in the app to bring your stars with you
Fixed: the update button no longer shows up during a run when there's no update
Better: manuals are easier. Tilt the iPad a little less to pop onto two wheels, and you stay up longer when you slow down
New: going to fly past the landing? Tap on the way down in the air to drop faster and aim for the slope
Better: every jump on every track now lands you on a downhill slope, whether you go slow or super fast, so you keep your flow
Better: lamps and torches glow smoothly like real lights, and the sun and moon cast shadows from you, the trees and everything else
Better: the wheels sound less boomy as you roll along

Better: street lamps light up the ground at night, and night tracks with no lamps get flaming torches. Trees and props have soft shadows underneath and a glow around their edges, so everything looks less flat
Better: landings smack down with the sound of the wheels hitting the ground, and rolling along is quieter

New: sound! Every surface sounds different: clacking concrete, hollow wooden boardwalk, crunchy snow, gritty sand, clunky temple stones and rough lava rock. Rails ring, ledges scrape and logs rasp when you grind, and every world has its own sounds around you, like waves, birds, city traffic, wind and bubbling lava. Turn it off on the title screen
New: put the game on your home screen! On the iPad tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It opens full screen and works without the internet
Better: lava gaps bubble and glow, getting darker the deeper they go

New: every track has its own landmarks to spot, like a ferris wheel, lighthouse, shipwreck, blimp, helicopter, ski jump, igloo, saloon, rock arch, jungle temple, waterfall, lava fall and giant dinosaur bones
Better: water gaps have ripples instead of a flat white top

New: every track has its own weather or time of day. Ride at sunrise, sunset or at night under the stars, in rain, mist, snowstorms and sandstorms, under the northern lights, or while the volcano erupts
Fixed: trees, palms, lamps and other scenery were sunk into the ground or lying on their side. They stand up properly now
Better: fences follow the hills, the ski lift has cables and chairs, and the snowy mountains and desert mesas look like real ones
New: 10 Volcano tracks to finish the game, with lava gaps, rails over lava, lava tube loops and one last giant leap into the crater
New: 10 Jungle Ruins tracks to ride to the beat, with river gaps, log grinds, temple steps and a waterfall jump
New: 10 Desert Canyon tracks, with deep gullies to pump out of, rails across them, and your first loop-the-loops
New: 10 Snowy Mountain tracks, with crevasses, a frozen lake, down rails and giant kickers for backflips
New: 10 Downtown Rooftops tracks, with gaps between buildings, stair sets, handrails and giant billboard jumps
New: mega ramps! Drop in from way up high, jump the giant gap, then fly off the quarter pipe. You get three drops
New: 10 Beach Boardwalk tracks to ride, with water gaps, pier rails and big swells, and 3 challenges on each
New: 10 Sunny Park tracks! Each one teaches a move, and has 3 challenges. Do them to earn stars and open the next track
Better: the ollie is bigger and slower: a deep crouch, a big tail snap, then he springs up and tucks his knees
Fixed: dropping into a half pipe no longer stalls for a moment at the top, so you fly down the wall
Better: dropping into a half pipe gives you more speed, so you get air straight away
New: after an update, What's New opens by itself and shows what each update added
New: half pipes start up on the edge. Tap to drop in, and the clock starts when you do
Better: a real ollie! Snap the tail, slide your front foot up, tuck your knees and bend them to land
Fixed: the dips in Dry Gulch are smoother, so you can pump through them instead of flying into the far side
Better: ollie just before a rail and you hop right onto it
Better: the snowboard's nose and tail kick up like a real one
New: loop-the-loops in the Jungle and Volcano! Pump hard to get round
New: on a rail, swipe on the right for a Boardslide, 5-0 or Nosegrind!
New: grind rails, ledges and stair sets! Ollie onto a rail to grind it
New: watch your best tricks again in slow-mo! Tap REPLAY after a big combo
New: ride a snowboard on the snow level, with a beanie and goggles!
Fixed: the update button now makes sure you really get the new version
New: the title screen shows which version you have
New: a Trick Guide on the main menu shows every move
Fixed: the skater's legs no longer poke through the ground
New: the game tells you when there's an update, and what's in it!
New: spins! Swipe sideways along the bottom of the screen
New: tilt the iPad to do manuals on the ground and flips in the air
New: grabs! Swipe and hold on the left side of the screen
New: a half-pipe bonus level in every world
New: three lives on every track
New: six worlds to skate, from the beach to a volcano
